svg.aria-label: Start C4 + E4, end B3 + E4. The lower voice moves from C4 to B3, down 1 semitone. The upper voice holds E4. Result: a perfect fourth, 5 semitones. Second panel: Start C4 + E4, end D4 + E4. The lower voice moves from C4 to D4, up 2 semitones. The upper voice holds E4. Result: a major second, 2 semitones.
svg.title: The foundation can travel

g.text: How to read this graphic: Each keyboard
starts from the same pair, C4 and E4, shown
by dashed marks. Read the arrow above the
keys to see which way the lower voice went
and by how much, then read the badges for the
new pair. The keyboard starts at B3, so the
key just below C4 is on the picture.
